text:
Riley M: Idea: run a handwritten postcard drop next Friday tied to the coffee cart. tiny gesture, high goodwill. who wants to pilot?
Ava (People Ops): Love this. We did digital before but not physical notes. Budget? Time to print envelopes/postcards?
Carlos V: Vendor turnaround for 100 postcards is 3 days with external vendor, 1 day with internal if we keep it b/w. Color will add cost.
Maya L: I can coordinate copy and a simple layout. Prefer short prompts on the back: name, note, team, one sentence.
Ben T: I'll organize coffee-cart coverage so baristas can hand out postcards + pens. Two locations: main lobby and 3rd floor kitchen.
Riley M: Thinking distribution window 8:30-10:30 to catch morning crowd. Also want a drop table for managers to sign a few cards.
Samir H: I can recruit 6 volunteers. Suggest sign-up slots of 30 mins.
Ava (People Ops): Budget cap of $200 for printing + supplies. Can finance approve gift line?
FinanceBot: Expense check: assign code PO-PRIDE-2026, tentative approval pending manual review. ETA 1 business day.
Maya L: Draft copy suggestion: front: small icon + "One quick thanks"; back prompt: "To: \nFrom: \nWhy I appreciate you: (one line)"
Riley M: Nice. Also add micro-instructions for managers: "Sign 1 card per direct report this week"
Carlos V: Supplies note: need pens, postcard weight stock, small clipboard for signers, a box for completed cards to route to Mailroom.
MailroomBot: Mailroom pickup scheduled: request ID 7789. Please confirm ready-by time and routing address.
Ava (People Ops): If mailroom pickup confirmed, we can offer to hand-deliver to remote folks via stamped envelopes if budget allows. Samir, any volunteers willing to stuff + stamp after event?
Samir H: Happy to coordinate stuffing. Need 2 more folks for midday assembly.
Ben T: Coffee-cart team confirmed for both locations. We will hand out a maximum of 150 cards to avoid waste.
Riley M: Can we pre-print a short list of suggestions on the table to help people write quickly? e.g., "helped unblock my deploy", "great mentorship", "brilliant code review"
Maya L: I'll design a 3-up cheat-sheet card for the table. Minimal branding.
Ava (People Ops): Approve printing internal B/W for cost. If Finance approves the $200 we can do color for front accent.
FinanceBot: Manual review complete: $200 approved under budget line PO-PRIDE-2026. Please attach receipt after purchase.
Carlos V: I'll place internal print job now for 150 postcards + 200 pens and 100 envelopes. Lead time 24 hours.
Riley M: Volunteer schedule: Samir (8:00-10:00 setup + stuffing), Maya (8:30-9:30), Ben (9:30-10:30 on table), Carlos (10:00-11:00 breakdown). Need one more for 8:30-9:00.
Ava (People Ops): I can cover 8:30-9:00. Also will prepare manager nudge with sample sign-offs and suggested wording.
Riley M: Sample manager nudge copy paste: "Morning team-- next Friday we'll have a quick handwritten postcard station + coffee in the lobby. Please swing by and sign a short note for someone who made an impact. One line is fine. We'll collect and route cards to recipients and remote folks. Thanks!"
Maya L: Love it. Also propose a small label: "Please put completed card in the box for routing"
MailroomBot: Pickup confirmed for Friday 12:00. Routing: HQ internal mail -> distribution bundle. Remote envelope batch requires stamps; confirm to charge PO.
Ava (People Ops): Confirmed. We'll use PO to cover postage for remote deliveries. Samir: plan for stuffing and stamping at 11:30 after cards are collected.
Samir H: Noted. I'll bring tape and stamp rolls.
Riley M: Final checklist: print job ordered, PO approved, volunteers set, coffee-cart confirmed, mailroom pickup scheduled, manager nudge queued. Anything else?
Ben T: Table signage and a small bin for used pens to keep table tidy.
Ava (People Ops): Great work team :sparkles: We'll run this as a one-off pilot and record feedback. I'll post a short feedback form in this thread after the run.
Riley M: Thanks everyone. Posting the final assets (poster, cheat-sheet, runbook) here tonight.
Ava (People Ops): See you Friday! :coffee:
